sources.title: Black Forest Labs Releases FLUX 3: A Multimodal Flow Model for Image ...
sources.snippet: Black Forest Labs (BFL) has released FLUX 3, a multimodal foundation model that learns from images, videos and audio inside a single architecture. It is also the first FLUX model to ship video, audio and action prediction from one set of weights. The Black Forest Labs (BFL) research team argues that no single modality gives a complete description of the world. Images capture spatial structure ...
